title.en: Environmental Public Health (Registration of Environmental Control Coordinators and Environmental Control Officers) Regulations 2021

completenessNote: 全文，共 13 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Environmental Public Health (Registration of Environmental Control Coordinators and Environmental Control Officers) Regulations 2021 and come into operation on 20 July 2021.

chapter.en: PART 2 REGISTRATION OF ENVIRONMENTAL CONTROL COORDINATORS

heading.en: Application for registration as Environmental Control Coordinator for specified premises

text.en:
3.—(1) An individual who wishes to be registered as an Environmental Control Coordinator for any specified premises must apply to the Director‑General for the registration in accordance with this regulation.
[S 249/2025 wef 07/04/2025]
(2) An application for registration as an Environmental Control Coordinator for any specified premises must —
(a)be made to the Director‑General in the form and manner that the Director‑General requires;
(b)be accompanied by the information and documents that the Director‑General requires; and
(c)be accompanied by the relevant fee specified in the Schedule.
[S 249/2025 wef 07/04/2025]
[S 249/2025 wef 07/04/2025]

chapter.en: PART 2 REGISTRATION OF ENVIRONMENTAL CONTROL COORDINATORS

heading.en: Registration as Environmental Control Coordinator for specified premises

text.en:
4.—(1) The Director‑General may, subject to any condition that the Director‑General thinks fit to impose, register an applicant mentioned in regulation 3 as an Environmental Control Coordinator for any specified premises if the Director‑General is satisfied that —
(a)the applicant —
(i)has been certified under the Workplace Literacy and Numeracy framework to have a proficiency level of at least 5 in the areas of reading, listening, speaking and writing; or
(ii)has such other qualifications and practical experience that renders the applicant competent to act as an Environmental Control Coordinator for any specified premises;
[S 249/2025 wef 07/04/2025]
(b)the applicant has, within 5 years before the date on which the application is made, attended and passed any training courses specified by the Director-General for the purpose of the registration; and
[S 85/2026 wef 01/03/2026]
(c)the applicant is of good character and reputation.
[S 249/2025 wef 07/04/2025]
(2) When an individual is registered as an Environmental Control Coordinator for any specified premises, the Director‑General must issue to the individual, in the form and manner the Director‑General determines, a certificate of registration that states —
(a)the full name of the individual; and
(b)the unique registration number assigned to the individual for the registration.
[S 249/2025 wef 07/04/2025]
(3) The registration of an Environmental Control Coordinator for any specified premises is valid for a period of 3 years.
[S 249/2025 wef 07/04/2025]
[S 249/2025 wef 07/04/2025]

chapter.en: PART 2 REGISTRATION OF ENVIRONMENTAL CONTROL COORDINATORS

heading.en: Application for renewal of registration as Environmental Control Coordinator for specified premises

text.en:
5.—(1) An Environmental Control Coordinator for any specified premises who wishes to renew his or her registration as such must apply to the Director‑General for the renewal of the registration before the registration expires, in accordance with this regulation.
[S 249/2025 wef 07/04/2025]
(2) An application under paragraph (1) must —
(a)be made to the Director‑General in the form and manner that the Director‑General requires;
(b)be accompanied by the information and documents that the Director‑General requires; and
(c)be accompanied by the relevant fee specified in the Schedule.
[S 249/2025 wef 07/04/2025]

chapter.en: PART 2 REGISTRATION OF ENVIRONMENTAL CONTROL COORDINATORS

heading.en: Renewal of registration as Environmental Control Coordinator for specified premises

text.en:
6.—(1) After receiving an application under regulation 5 from an Environmental Control Coordinator for any specified premises (called in this regulation the applicant), the Director‑General may, subject to any condition that the Director‑General thinks fit to impose, renew the registration of the applicant as an Environmental Control Coordinator for any specified premises if the Director‑General is satisfied that —
(a)the applicant has, within 5 years before the date on which the application is made, passed any assessments specified by the Director-General for the purpose of the renewal of the registration; and
[S 85/2026 wef 01/03/2026]
(b)the applicant is of good character and reputation.
[S 249/2025 wef 07/04/2025]
(2) When the registration of an individual as an Environmental Control Coordinator for any specified premises is renewed, the Director‑General must issue to the individual, in the form and manner the Director‑General determines, a certificate of registration that states —
(a)the full name of the individual; and
(b)the unique registration number assigned to the individual for the renewed registration.
[S 249/2025 wef 07/04/2025]
[S 249/2025 wef 07/04/2025]

chapter.en: PART 3 REGISTRATION OF ENVIRONMENTAL CONTROL OFFICERS

heading.en: Application for registration as Environmental Control Officer

text.en:
7.—(1) An individual who wishes to be registered as an Environmental Control Officer for specified premises or for specified construction sites must apply to the Director‑General for the registration in accordance with this regulation.
(2) An application for registration as an Environmental Control Officer must —
(a)be made to the Director‑General in the form and manner that the Director‑General requires;
(b)be accompanied by the information and documents that the Director‑General requires; and
(c)be accompanied by the relevant fee specified in the Schedule.

chapter.en: PART 3 REGISTRATION OF ENVIRONMENTAL CONTROL OFFICERS

text.en:
8.—(1) The Director‑General may, subject to any condition that the Director‑General thinks fit to impose, register an applicant mentioned in regulation 7 as an Environmental Control Officer for specified premises or for specified construction sites if the Director‑General is satisfied that —
(a)the applicant —
(i)has been certified under the Workplace Literacy and Numeracy framework to have a proficiency level of at least 7 in the areas of reading, listening, numeracy, speaking and writing;
(ii)has at least 2 years of relevant work experience, and has been certified under the Workplace Literacy and Numeracy framework to have a proficiency level of at least 6 in the areas of reading, listening, numeracy, speaking and writing; or
(iii)has such other qualifications and practical experience that renders the applicant competent to act as an Environmental Control Officer;
(b)the applicant has attended and passed —
(i)in the case where the application is for registration as an Environmental Control Officer for specified premises — such training courses specified by the Director‑General for the purpose of the registration; or
[S 249/2025 wef 07/04/2025]
(ii)in the case where the application is for registration as an Environmental Control Officer for specified construction sites — within 5 years before the date on which the application is made, such training courses specified by the Director‑General for the purpose of the registration; and
[S 249/2025 wef 07/04/2025]
(c)the applicant is of good character and reputation.
(2) When an individual is registered as an Environmental Control Officer, the Director‑General must issue to the individual, in the form and manner the Director‑General determines, a certificate of registration that states —
(a)the full name of the individual;
(b)the unique registration number assigned to the individual for the registration; and
(c)whether the individual is authorised to act as an Environmental Control Officer for —
(i)any specified construction site; or
(ii)any specified premises.
(3) The registration of an Environmental Control Officer is valid for a period of 3 years.

chapter.en: PART 3 REGISTRATION OF ENVIRONMENTAL CONTROL OFFICERS

heading.en: Application for renewal of registration as Environmental Control Officer

text.en:
9.—(1) An Environmental Control Officer who wishes to renew his or her registration as such must apply to the Director‑General for the renewal of the registration before the registration expires, in accordance with this regulation.
(2) An application under paragraph (1) must —
(a)be made to the Director‑General in the form and manner that the Director‑General requires;
(b)be accompanied by the information and documents that the Director‑General requires; and
(c)be accompanied by the relevant fee specified in the Schedule.

chapter.en: PART 3 REGISTRATION OF ENVIRONMENTAL CONTROL OFFICERS

heading.en: Renewal of registration as Environmental Control Officer

text.en:
10.—(1) After receiving an application under regulation 9 from an Environmental Control Officer (called in this regulation the applicant), the Director‑General may, subject to any condition that the Director‑General thinks fit to impose, renew the registration of the applicant as an Environmental Control Officer if the Director‑General is satisfied that —
(a)the applicant has passed —
(i)in the case where the applicant is registered as an Environmental Control Officer for specified premises — such assessments specified by the Director‑General for the purpose of the renewal of the registration; or
[S 249/2025 wef 07/04/2025]
(ii)in the case where the applicant is registered as an Environmental Control Officer for specified construction sites — within 5 years before the date on which the application is made, such assessments specified by the Director‑General for the purpose of the renewal of the registration;
[S 249/2025 wef 07/04/2025]
(b)the applicant has, within 3 years before the date on which the application is made, successfully completed the courses or training relating to the duties of an Environmental Control Officer specified by the Director-General for the purpose of the renewal of the registration; and
[S 249/2025 wef 07/04/2025]
(c)the applicant is of good character and reputation.
(2) When the registration of an individual as an Environmental Control Officer is renewed, the Director‑General must issue to the individual, in the form and manner the Director‑General determines, a certificate of registration that states —
(a)the full name of the individual;
(b)the unique registration number assigned to the individual for the renewed registration; and
(c)whether the individual is authorised to act as an Environmental Control Officer for —
(i)any specified construction site; or
(ii)any specified premises.
11. The Environmental Public Health (Qualifications of Environmental Control Officers) Notification (N 2) is cancelled.

12.—(1) Every certificate of registration that is issued under regulation 3(5) of the Environmental Public Health (Registration of Environmental Control Officers) Regulations (Rg 2) before 20 July 2021 and is in force immediately before that date, is to continue in force as if the certificate of registration were issued under regulation 8(2) of these Regulations.
(2) A certificate of registration mentioned in paragraph (1) that is expressed to continue in force for a definite period ceases to be in force after the expiration of that period unless the registration to which that certificate of registration relates is renewed before its expiry in accordance with these Regulations.
(3) Any application made under the Environmental Public Health (Registration of Environmental Control Officers) Regulations before 20 July 2021 for the registration or the renewal of the registration of an individual as an Environmental Control Officer authorised to act for any specified construction site, that is still pending on or after that date, is to be treated as if that application were made under regulation 7 or 9 (respectively) of these Regulations.
